info.name: IRoad Mobile Driver — Job Detail Module
info.description:
# IRoad Mobile — Job Detail Module

## Prerequisites
1. Import **IRoad Mobile Driver Job Detail — Local** environment.
2. Set `base_url`, `email`, `password`, optional `tenant_id`.
3. Run **Setup → Login**.
4. Run **00 — Resolve IDs** (sets `shipment_id` / `movement_id`).
5. Run **08 — Smoke Flows → Flow A** in Collection Runner.

## Capabilities
| Route type | Capability |
|------------|------------|
| GET detail / timeline / allowed-actions | `mobile.driver.jobs` |
| POST execute / upload-pod / collect-cod | `mobile.driver.jobs.execute` |

## Docs
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_job_detail.md`
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_job_detail_execution.md`
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_job_timeline.md`
- `mobile_api/docs/driver_job_pod_cod.md`
- `postman/README-JobDetail.md`
